title: Styling
guidance: One flowing present-tense paragraph, under about 200 words.
Start with the main action, then movement and gestures, appearance, environment, camera, lighting and colour.
LTX-2.5 audio: describe ambient sound, put dialogue in quotes with the speaker, name any music.
Styling sets the overall visual identity. Choose exactly one.

entries.label: Cinematic realistic
entries.prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic live-action look with natural textures, shallow depth of field and realistic skin and fabric detail.
entries.notes: Good general default for story work.

entries.label: Documentary
entries.prompt: A natural documentary look, with available light, candid framing and unposed, authentic behaviour.
entries.notes: Pairs with handheld and natural neutral grade.

entries.label: Commercial product
entries.prompt: A polished commercial product look, with immaculate surfaces, crisp reflections, controlled studio lighting and a clean backdrop.
entries.negative: clutter, fingerprints, dust, distorted logos, garbled text

entries.label: Photoreal (no stylisation)
entries.prompt: A grounded photographic look, true to life, with sharp detail and neutral styling.
entries.negative: anime, cartoon, cel shading, illustration, 3d render

entries.label: Vintage 16mm
entries.prompt: A vintage 16mm film look, with visible grain, soft edges, slight gate weave and faded warm colours.
entries.notes: Pairs with Kodak grade; avoid with clean commercial.

entries.label: Music video
entries.prompt: A stylised music video look, with bold framing, expressive colour, dynamic movement and performance-led energy.
entries.notes: Pairs with upbeat or synth music.

entries.label: Epic trailer
entries.prompt: An epic film-trailer look, with grand scale, dramatic contrast, intense close-ups and sweeping vistas.

entries.label: Social UGC
entries.prompt: A casual social-video look, shot like a phone, with direct-to-camera energy, natural light and a friendly, authentic feel.
